# catalyst_functions (Data Source)

List existing serverless Function identities. Requires `ZohoCatalyst.functions.ALL` and project access. Uses the official CLI's metadata API. It does not deploy or invoke Functions and does not expose environment variables. Results are sorted lexicographically by ID. An empty project returns an empty list; denied access or malformed responses return an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "catalyst_functions" "example" {
  project_id = var.project_id
}

output "functions" {
  value = data.catalyst_functions.example.functions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Existing project's positive numeric ID, written as a string.

### Read-Only

- `functions` (Attributes List) Existing infrastructure, sorted by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--functions))

<a id="nestedatt--functions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `functions`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Numeric ID represented as a string without loss of precision.
- `name` (String) Name reported by Catalyst.
